notes.title: Cultivation Tales Official S2 Season Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear fellow Taoists,
Cultivation Tales Official S1 Season will end at 24:00 on July 26, 2024, and will undergo a shutdown update. The official S2 season is expected to start at 10:00 on July 30.

===New Content===
1.[b]【Weapon - Umbrella】[/b]
Fellow Taoists can obtain and use the brand new weapon "Umbrella", as well as new Five Elements moves and attacks waiting for everyone to experience!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/d9061923a025c14ade39ca86136e3f096dd7f128.png[/img]
2.[b]【Hundred Ghosts Night Journey Gameplay】[/b]
Shared World has added a new gameplay called Hundred Ghosts Night Walk. Daoists can go to Shared World to view detailed instructions. Eliminate all ghosts, build arrow towers, and guard the wilderness.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/55ebcceb0ec7052352006c63e810288a703e4919.jpg[/img]
3.[b]【New season pass rewards】[/b]
The game's main body is priced at 68 yuan. By purchasing the main body, players can play cooperative mode and season mode, while unlocking regular passes.
（1）Regular version pass: You can obtain it by purchasing the main body. The regular pass reward for the S2 season includes two sets of limited edition "Shuiyun" fashion, which can be upgraded to the advanced version of the pass. After unlocking the pass, completing achievement tasks can earn rich game item rewards.
（2）Advanced version pass: It can be upgraded from a regular pass and is priced at 38 yuan. The S2 Season Advanced Pass rewards include two sets of limited edition "Shui Yun" fashion and two sets of high-quality limited edition "Lan" fashion, as well as rewards for limited weapon appearances, title effects, and chat actions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/7e0a11676ecb714fa4ea22b9c86d801b195d075d.png[/img]

===Adjust and optimize the content===
1. Fixed the issue of abnormal return to the sect during the expedition
2. Fixed the issue of abnormal determination of expedition times
3. Fixed the issue of occasional abnormal departure time
4. Fixed the issue of occasional abnormal loading of skin models
5. Fixed the issue of occasional falling objects not being successfully picked up

notes.title: Cultivation Tales Official S1 Season Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear fellow Taoists,
The S7 season of the early trial version of "Cultivation Tales" will end at 10:00 on April 17, 2024, and there will be a shutdown update. The official S1 season is expected to start at 10:00 on April 18.

===New content===
1.[b] [Instrument Spirit System][/b]
Players can use this system to enhance their weapon abilities, obtain attribute enhancements, and ultimately have a chance to obtain more powerful evolved moves! Add a consumable item called "Artifact Spirit", which can be produced by adding a dungeon called "Sword Tomb" and support free trading;
Add a new wild dungeon called "Sword Tomb", challenge dungeons and defeat lords to obtain artifact spirits.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/44de3d51c942fa680966874c7d74661f7649e6de.png[/img]
2. [b][Cross Season Inheritance System - Sanshengshi][/b]
At the Three Lives Stone, players can store some of their cultivation, moves, spells, and equipment from this season until the next season, and choose to spend a certain cost to take them out and inherit them in the next season. The cultivation motivation is even stronger every season!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/56ba7577365d637bfe8405420e4c596904627c4b.jpg[/img]
3.[b] [Expedition Gameplay - Thunder Formation][/b]
The attacking side has added a "Thunder Formation", which can be deployed and summon Thunder Formation puppets to assist in the attack. The battle between the attacking and defending sides will become even more intense!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/3060904c67737d5519ae67fcc60c042f4c08d1f7.jpg[/img]
4. [b][Arena gameplay][/b]
Add an arena on the second floor of the Five Elements Tower. 1V1 competitive confrontation, enjoy the fun of battle to the fullest; Win with pride, compete for higher point rankings, and earn honors to exchange for generous rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/ae86031c5d12535349cd6baabc8264addf550fa9.png[/img]
5. [b]Rewards for new season passes[/b]
The game's main body is priced at 68 yuan. By purchasing the main body, players can play in both cooperative and season modes, while unlocking a regular pass.
(1) Regular version pass: You can obtain it by purchasing the main body. The S1 season regular pass reward includes two sets of limited "flying" fashion, which can be upgraded to the advanced version of the pass. After unlocking the pass, completing achievement tasks can earn rich game item rewards.
(2) Advanced version of the pass: It can be upgraded from a regular pass and is priced at 38 yuan. The S1 season advanced pass rewards include two sets of limited "flying" fashion and two sets of high-quality limited "snake" fashion, as well as rewards for limited weapon appearance, title special effects, and chat actions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39619490/9cd68a52ffe25b5353711ed0248b9f3fd6003efc.png[/img]

===Adjusting and optimizing content===
1. Adjust the departure time: The departure time will be changed to 18:00-23:00.
2. Cancel the trading bank system and gift function.
3. The recharge entrance and the first recharge activity are activated.

After the official S1 season update, a massive number of welfare activities will be launched simultaneously. Rich rewards such as treasure chests, limited titles, spirit stones, opening orders, and massive game resources are waiting for everyone to participate! Stay tuned for our upcoming event announcements~
Thank you all for your support and trust. Looking forward to meeting everyone in tales in the official S1 season!

notes.title: 11月10日，S3赛季，新增内容与改动
notes.content:
各位道友：
太荒初境即将与11月10日14点迎来全新赛季（S3），感谢各位支持，我们会继续努力！

[h2]=====【新增内容】=====[/h2]
[h3]1.战场模式[/h3]
    通过战鼓匹配进入战场，战场全天开放，玩法休闲，可获得古币奖励
    (a)人数：最低2人可开始回合对战，最多可容纳10v10，回合开始时系统会自动[随机平衡]人员分配
    (b)胜利：成功占领任意2个点位那方或回合内占领进度较多那方，获得胜利，每回合限时8分钟
    (c)奖励：每回合结算可获得古币、积分。积分可在战场内购买装备物品，古币可以回宗门秘境的“副本商人”中购买物资
    (d)结算：一方阵营率先获得5回合胜利则战场结束，对战期间可以加入新人，同样，中途离场也会正常结算古币
    (e)限制：进入战场时只能携带刻石进入，用局内积分购买武器装备，法宝需要在地图中抢夺
[h3]2.无尽之海地图[/h3]
    (a)海底秘密入口进入深渊裂隙
    (b)海面浮空岛
[h3]3.新增武器[/h3]
    (a)长枪
[h3]4.新增商品类型[/h3]
    (a)背饰
[h3]5.新增商品[/h3]
    (a)角色皮肤、武器皮肤
[h3]6.新增S3赛季个人荣誉奖励皮肤[/h3]
    (a)战鼓中通过个人荣誉值可以获得皮肤：银翼蔷薇（男女）

[h2]=====【修改内容】=====[/h2]
[h3]1.铁匠修改[/h3]
    (a)可以锁定1条属性，初始有30%几率被保留，随机剩余4条属性，并祭炼一个同类型的装备
    (b)属性的炼化期为固定1小时，赠送物品可提高那条被锁定属性保留的几率，最高达到100%
    (c)赠送“华光异彩·鸿蒙”或“华光异彩·仙元”后可额外将1条属性转移至炼化装备上，但此时这2条属性保留的成功几率最多80%
[h3]2.经验限制修改[/h3]
    (a)重新修改每日获得经验上限，并限制获得经验满额后不在获得经验
    (b)等级最大上限150级，问鼎10之后各属性每升1级加1点
[h3]3.新材料[/h3]
    (a)在青龙副本商人中添加新材料“华光异彩.鸿蒙”，在白虎副本商人中添加“华光异彩.仙元”
[h3]4.修改属性[/h3]
    (a)“无视防御”修改为“真实伤害”同时调整数值上限，只能在首饰上出现
    (b)装备上添加新属性“护甲穿透”，每1点护甲穿透都会降低敌人1%的护甲值
    (c)下调闪避属性的上限值
    (d)格挡时，抵御的伤害越多则损失的体力越多
    (e)低级装备也可以洗出高级采集词条，提高了采集属性上限数值
    (f)上调了仙元装备武器的基础属性20%~50%
[h3]5.抗性[/h3]
    (a)灵根抗性降低对应异常状态累计的效果增加50%
[h3]6.法宝攻击逻辑[/h3]
    (a)修改法宝的攻击逻辑，法宝不再会自动攻击，仅会攻击玩家攻击过的敌人或攻击你的玩家
[h3]7.武器平衡性调整[/h3]
    (a)短弓：增加射程20%并增加多段技能的伤害系数6%
        i.弓箭普通攻击攻速增加30%，蓄力时间减少1倍
        ii.取消弓箭伤害随着攻击距离递减设定
    (b)双刀：降低技能CD 15%
        i.锁定技不再能击倒敌人而是附带击退效果，大剑除外
        ii.技能“极寒”可以在移动中释放
    (c)大锤：增加技能的释放速度8%，并提升大锤武器攻击力10%
    (d)关刀：增加技能的释放速度15%，并降低技能CD 5%
        i.锁定技范围增加50%，释放速度提升25%
        ii.“飞霜”不再能施加冰冻效果
    (e)剑盾：“疾驰”不再能施加冰冻效果
    (f)重新调整所有武器技能在高等级时的技能消耗 
[h3]8.术法修改[/h3]
    (a)回溯初始持续时间11秒，随后每级提升1秒，CD固定为260秒不会随等级增加
    (b)玄冥寒气每次冰冻时间为0.5
[h3]9.法宝修改[/h3]
    (a)虬困普通攻击禁锢敌人固定为1.5秒，法宝大招“镇妖”初始禁锢敌人2秒，随后每级提升0.2秒
[h3]10.灵符修改[/h3]
    (a)释放灵符时为霸体状态，不可被打断
    (b)水灵符的冰冻效果修改为2s
    (c)木大灵符效果修改为降低攻城车受到的伤害20%
[h3]11.交易行[/h3]
    (a)上架物品不在需要手续费，成交后扣除上架手续费
[h3]12.出征[/h3]
    (a)出征时摆放攻城车的数量上限调整为10辆车并且大幅增加攻城车初始血量，此外，会根据守方人数成倍增加攻城车的额外血量，攻城车在被攻击时不能发射炮弹也不能被移动。注意：车的血量最终会叠加到原来几十倍
    (b)在出征时玩家每死亡3次可以在重生界面选择一次强化增益：属性攻击8%，护甲5%，物理攻击12%，生命5%
    (c)出征胜利后，将获得装备、武器、首饰、刻石、稀有材料等奖励
[h3]13.渡劫[/h3]
    (a)渡劫伤害会随渡劫时间提高而随机提高1%到150%
	
[h2]=====【计划内容】=====[/h2]
S3赛季进行中将会更新以下内容：
1.海底副本，海底副本BOSS
2.五行塔内小玩法
3.休闲钓鱼玩法

notes.title: 【公告】也许，需要重新认识我们
notes.content:
首先，感谢各位道友一路支持！

    我是刘龙，对，就是你们经常骂的那个刘龙。虽然你们骂我，但是也是因为你们喜欢太荒这游戏，对它期望很大才骂的。这个赛季很多人都提前毕业了，我们游戏设定是毕业了的玩家可以冲榜，毕竟是PVP服，但是毕业这么快确实这个赛季的数值节奏没把握对造成的，我们确实需要检讨和抱歉。

    关于很多玩家说我们画饼不作为，然后开始带节奏，我这里放出截图大家老玩家可以共睹一下，我们人员目前：客户端程序（刘龙）+服务器程序+4位其他战友，刘龙每天的事情远比你们想象的多，负责运营的0号早已离职，刘龙同时需要管运营的事情，所以写代码时间平均最多只能占30%，就这样我们还是会不断压榨自己，为大家呈现美好的太荒世界，不为别的，就为这个游戏能走下去，它是我们的理想。

    我还是真心希望大家能理解和认可我们，虽然游戏能给你们带来各种情绪，但是我希望带来快乐要更多一些，如果给你带来太多其他负面情绪，说实话这游戏就失去了它本来的意义，我认为玩游戏就是要快乐呀。

    不论目前大环境如何，我们一定会坚持做我们自己！

各位道友：

可转数据：
1. 玩家境界
2. 装备、饰品、刻石、法宝、术法

        转宗逻辑为：你先申请加入其它宗门（一定要进入那个宗门一次），这时你就在那个宗门拥有了一个凡人的角色，然后你再回到原来的老宗门使用转宗令，使用时输入新宗门的ID，这样就可以把你在老宗门的数据转移到新宗门去了，新宗门的数据就会被覆盖，老宗门的数据将会被清空。
        [i][b][u]重点注意：以上可知转宗令可以携带一些物资离开老宗门，所以老宗门的宗主一定要管理好你们的成员，注意调整权限、调整物资箱，避免出现有成员恶意携带物资转宗。[/u][/b][/i]

At the same time, as the game enters re-launch process, the currently unconditional refund will also be closed from May 3. notes.title: Introducing Season 1 and brand new PVE mode
notes.content:
As the Season 0 is coming to an end, our Season 1 and offline PVE mode have also entered the internal testing phase. The cooperative mode in offline mode will add the "Building a Home from Anywhere" function, which was highly anticipated among players, and will meet with players soon. The S1 season will start in early May, and the specific time depends on the stability of the game build. The following are the details of the new version:

[b]【New PVE Mode】[/b]
The PVE mode would changed to P2P multiplayer mode, no official server, no need to worry about the problem of server down. Player can host a game session by your own computer, and other members can join in. When the host exits, other players will be kicked out and the shared cloud save will be uploaded, then any other member can use the cloud save to re-host the game session. 

[b]In the PVE mode, home building has been changed to free building, not only in the small world up in the sky, but also in any location in the continent.[/b]

The PVE mode cancels the demon invasion.

[b]【Spirit Potential Skill】[/b]
It is expected to be launched in June. Different spiritual potential have an exclusive skill, which fully matches the performance of the corresponding attributes.

[b]【Artifacts Skill】[/b]
It is expected to be launched in July and August. Each Artifacts will have its own ultimate skill. 

[b]【new content development plan】[/b]
At the same time, various new contents are being planned in the near future. Our goal is to gradually implement the various immortal cultivation settings. At the same time, we will also actively listen to players' suggestions and add other content with higher expectations. The following are the details of the new content and the estimated development time. The ordering has nothing to do with the launch time order:

(1), mount and pet system (2 months of development)
You can get Neidan by subduing animals and beasts in the game, and Neidan can hatch baby mounts in the animal pen. You can raise 5 pets at the same time, you can feed them with spirit fruit.
When the pets grows up, you can choose to carry it. Press the shortcut key to summon a mount and ride on it. Mounts will grow up, mutation may occur in the process of feeding, and the mutation will add an additional guardian skill.
A mount can not only be used for traveling, but it can also be used as a separate entity to fight with you. Each mount has a unique guardian skill, such as: intermittently increase the shield, HP, attack power, etc. 

(2) Lobby (1.5 months of development)
On the title screen, you can click to enter the chat server. This server does not have too much complicated logic, so it can be optimized better. About 50 people can enter at the same time. These players can type chat, chat with each other privately, and show their title realm skin.

(3) Air combat (1.5 months of development)
You can cast spell and magic when flying on the sword, it feels like driving a fighter jet. Different weapons have different sword light effects. When attacking, the weapon suspends behind you and makes a loud noise.
Air combat can be used for PVP and can also be used to attack monsters. At that time, we will launch an epic BOSS battle that requires aerial combat. Are you ready to fight Kun and the deep sea monster? 

(4) World BOSS Battlefield (2 months of development)
Multiple sects can reach a battlefield space at the same time. There is a sealed BOSS in the space. To defeat the BOSS, you must break a few sealing stones first, and whichever sect breaks the sealing stone last will increase the sealing ability to the team members of that sect.
If all five seal stones are broken, you can attack the boss.

(5) PVP battlefield (1.5 months of development)
Hit the drum to enter the PVP field, and a sect can participate in a team of 1-5 people. PVP in the field is scored according to the number of kills, and you can also get certain rewards after the end. Each PVP battle lasts about 20 minutes and up to 20 players can participate in PVP battlefield.

(6) Endless Sea (4 months of development)
At present, only rare plants can be collected in the endless seabed. In the later stage, a Penglai Hanging Immortal Island will be added a few hundred meters above the sea surface.
You can fly up to kill the boss above, and collect the fairy fruit above. At the same time, in the deep sea in the vertical downward direction of floated island, there are an entrance to the Dragon Palace, this is the secret realm of the endless sea. There will be some marine creatures and beasts in the underwater secret realm, and they are extremely strong, but the drops are also high value. The secret boss will be a giant sea dragon.

(7) Fishing system (1 month of development)
This is the traditional fishing system, there is nothing to describe.

(8) Bathing system (1 month of development)
Multiple people can take a bath in the water together, the effect is unknown.

notes.title: About the temporary server plan
notes.content:
Last night we had suffered another server down, yes, the 4th server down in 5 days.
Any explanation is weak, our incompetence and ignorance lead us to hurt the user experience time and time again. During these several server failures, we have found and fixed various problems, but last night, the CCU reached 36,000 and it failed again. We conducted an in-depth analysis of the architecture of the game and confirmed that the entire game needs adjustment.
The fundamental problem is that under the current structure, each player has one self-built sect, and each sect is equivalent to a small server. The average statistics are 2 people per sect, 36,000 online, equivalent to 18,000 small servers online at the same time, which has far exceeded the coping ability under the current architecture.
Yes, it seems like a stupid design now. In our previous tests, the highest one was the Steam GameFes, where the PCU reached more than 1200, and the server experience at that time was very smooth. We also did some marketing at that time, but it seems that there are not many players interested in our game. We expect that the PCU will reach several thousand at most after the release, and 10,000 is something we can't imagine. We have also done tens of thousands of PCU stress tests in a simulated environment with the most optimistic imagination, but this simulated environment is far from reality.
Now, we need to make a fundamental architectural change to the game, during which we will be working on a temporary solution, as follows:

[Temporary plan] There will be a limit on the number of sects that can be activated this time. If the limit is exceeded, you can bring your own character data to join other sects. When the number of simultaneous online sects reaches the upper limit, a prompt will pop up to remind players that they can join other sects. If they choose to continue to wait, it may take a very long time. If you choose to join other sects, backpacks, equipment, levels, magic weapons, moves, and spells will be brought to the new sect, and items in the sect cannot be carried. Personal sect data will be retained. We will temporarily turn off the delete button to prevent the new sect master from kicking people maliciously.
[Follow-up] The new version after changing the structure will be released in early May, the PVE mode will be changed to offline online mode, and the PVP mode will be changed to pass mode.

The server will be launched before 03:00 PDT today, and a temporary plan will be activated.

notes.title: Cultivation Tales-Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello fellow cultivators!

After a period of intense testing and development, we have finally presented this long-awaited fantasy world to all of you. The door to the mysterious land has been opened! Welcome everyone to cultivate immortals and become a master!

We choose to create such a work because our dev team members are all lovers of Xianxia culture, obsessed with flying on swords, taming evil creatures, chasing ancient alien beasts, etc. We don't want these to be just concepts that only exist on paper, but to create a wide and mysterious wonderland where you can move, interact, and play with your friends.
In this world, you can freely cultivate immortals, build, dig treasures, and forge magical weapons. Either compete with other sects in PVP mode or build with friends together to create your own world of immortals in PVE mode, you can enjoy in your own way in our game.

As a small team, we knew during the development process that the amount of work to complete the above content was very high, and the whole project is quite challenging. Thanks to the players and friends who have always supported us in our testing, we are very fortunate to have such a group of Xianxia game lovers to accompany us in our development. At present, since the game is still in the early stage, there may be some bugs or errors, and some game content has yet to be optimized. Thanks for your understanding and patience and we will be working on improving the game experience continuously.
